technology_name: ECO-FRIENDLY SYNTHESIS OF SILVER NANOPARTICLES WITH COFFEE LEAVES EXTRACT FOR CYSTEINE DETECTION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Detecting toxic systemic cysteine chemical spikes accurately normally requires destructive, high-overhead laboratory testing methodologies and toxic stabilizing chemical reagents.
description: An eco-friendly, single-step assay preparation protocol utilizing organic coffee leaves extract as an atom-economical reducing and capping matrix to synthesize highly stable colloidal silver nanoparticles ($AgNPs$) for colorimetric sensing.
applications: Water pollution monitoring kits, clinical biochemistry diagnostic strips, industrial effluent assay packs, and specialized laboratory chemical sensors.
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care, Water, Environment & Waste Management, Energy, Climate & Sustainability
